dedupe_keys.name: data for mapping the world s river levees a hyper resolution levee database based on digital elevation models

description: A Japanese research team publishes levee features extracted from elevation models for thirty-one countries. Zenodo provides a cases CSV and levee archive under CC BY-NC 4.0. The linked publications explain digital-elevation methods used to detect embankments; the public file list identifies the country inventory and spatial payload. These mapped features can seed flood-defence exposure and regional inundation simulations where levee locations matter. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this release. Coverage is thirty-one listed countries, not the entire world implied by the paper title or a verified engineering asset register. A limitation is that elevation-derived ridges can include natural or unrelated features and may miss low or narrow flood defences. The record does not by itself establish crest condition, failure probability or operating authority. No CSV or archive was downloaded, and no levee geometry was checked.
